sources.title: CAPP oil and gas infrastructure maps, October 2026
sources.method: Selected named corridors and facility capacities transcribed from the two source maps. Routes are indicative city-to-city diagrams, not digitized pipeline alignments.
sources.limitations: Selected infrastructure only. Capacity is not throughput. Facility markers represent cities or approximate localities, not surveyed sites.

sources.title: Natural Earth boundaries and populated places
sources.method: 50m administrative boundaries and 110m countries. Selected city coordinates from 10m populated places; other corridor waypoints approximate named localities.
sources.limitations: Generalized geography. Not for parcel, engineering or ground-disturbance decisions.
